title: Your progress
subtitle: Tick things off as you go. Small steps add up.
streakHint: Days in a row you opened the guide

daily.title: Daily tasks
daily.desc: Small things worth doing every day. Each gives XP, and they reset at midnight.

mail.label: Check your mail and email
mail.hint: Official letters from Migri, Kela, DVV or the tax office

finnish.label: Practise Finnish for 10 minutes
finnish.hint: An app, a podcast or the signs in a shop

say-hi.label: Talk to someone new
say-hi.hint: A classmate, a neighbour or the person at the café

todo.title: To do
todo.desc: The things almost every newcomer to Lahti has to sort out. Each one is done once.

before.title: Before you arrive
before.desc: Do these at home, ideally a few weeks ahead.

first48.title: First 48 hours
first48.desc: The basics for your first days in Lahti.

firstWeeks.title: First weeks
firstWeeks.desc: Official things and getting set up for your studies.

documents.label: Check your documents
documents.hint: Passport, residence permit if needed, admission letter

housing.label: Confirm your housing
housing.hint: Signed contract and a key pickup time

insurance.label: Check your health insurance
insurance.hint: Know what it covers before you need it

keys.label: Pick up your keys
keys.hint: Take photos of the flat's condition

sim.label: Get a phone number
sim.hint: Prepaid SIM from a kiosk, shop or supermarket

dvv.label: Register your address, if required
dvv.hint: DVV: bring passport, permit and rental contract

bank.label: Book a bank appointment
bank.hint: Bring passport, permit and student certificate

league.title: League
league.desc: Everyone using the guide in Lahti, ranked by XP. Finish to-do and daily tasks to climb.
league.loginPrompt: Log in to take your place in the league.
league.empty: Nobody is in the league yet.
